what_differs: Discovery named the BA's sales assistant as a Salesforce user group and Jay as an Ops/BA hybrid who logs sign-ups for a BA. Whether assistants get unique lower-permission logins (for audit) or share the BA login was left open on 2026-06-17 and again on 2026-07-07, pending license counts. No later meeting answers it, and no Jira ticket mentions assistants; WAGR-495 covers only Rep, Manager, Ops and Admin.
suggested_action: Add the question to WAGR-495 as an open persona decision (assistant: unique login vs shared; hybrid BA/Ops users: PSG combination) and ask WagerTech to decide before go-live user activation, since it affects license count and the audit trail.
